business_problem: Tahto needed to improve employee productivity and engagement in contact-center environments while preserving the empathetic, human-centered service experience expected by its clients.
solution_summary: Tahto chose IBM watsonx.data and IBM Cloud Pak for Data as the data architecture foundation for an AI-driven workforce intelligence program. The solution analyzes 112 key performance indicators across more than 200 business activities to align employee goals, objectives and achievements with operational outcomes. Those insights are then embedded in Tahto’s proprietary Guilda platform, which translates the analytics into personalized goal matrices, gamified experiences and targeted actions for agents and supervisors. By collapsing many fragmented performance processes into a smaller set of guided workflows, the architecture gives employees clearer direction while preserving room for human judgment in customer interactions. In practice, the platform moves data from workforce metrics into analytics and then into daily coaching and engagement workflows, letting Tahto manage large-scale contact-center operations with more precision, motivation and consistency.

solution_components.role: Stores and serves as the data foundation for Tahto’s workforce performance and behavior analytics.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloud Pak for Data
solution_components.role: Provides the platform used to operationalize analytics and AI transformation across Tahto’s workforce data.

business_outcome: Tahto reduced operating complexity, improved employee engagement and saved millions in costs while giving teams better visibility into the behaviors and goals that drive customer experience.
